summary.name: HeyVid
summary.one_liner: HeyVid is an online all-in-one AI video and image generator that gives access to multiple third-party video and image models from one platform.
use_cases: Turning text descriptions into short videos
Creating launch or crowdfunding campaign content
Producing pitch decks and brand story videos
summary.what_it_does: The page says HeyVid provides access to video models (named as Kling, Sora, Runway) and image models (named as Midjourney, Flux) in one place, with 18+ models in total. Users can generate video or images from text prompts or uploaded images, and the page mentions image animation, style transfer, and creative transformation. It also mentions music generation and tools for scriptwriting and storyboarding, though these are described only in general terms. The page offers a four-step workflow: choose a model, describe the vision, customize settings, and generate content.
notable: Single platform giving access to 18+ third-party video and image models including Kling, Sora, Runway, Midjourney and Flux
Text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation with style transfer
Listed as freemium in the hanishrao/collective-ai-tools directory
caveats: Pricing details and paid tiers are not described on the page; the 'free' claim in the meta description is marketing text
Page contains many promotional testimonials with no verifiable usage data; the '10 million users' figure is a claim on the page, not verified
